splits.method: stratified by family, 90/5/5 train/val/test, per-family shuffle with random.Random(42); same algorithm as v0.1-v0.4 (scripts/build_v01_dataset.py .. build_v04_dataset.py)

validation.note: v1.0 = v0.4 corpus (3,280, validated at v0.4) + batch 7 (1,720, flags from gen run 007, which included a mutation-tested intent-match self-check gate: 22/22 hand-corrupted rows caught). v1.0 completes the locked Cisco v0 scope (2026-11-22): 6 families, exactly 5,000 validated pairs. The full 5,000-row corpus was additionally audited with scripts/intent_match.py; residual flags are documented checker extraction limits (triaged, sample-verified), not data mismatches - see data/v1.0/intent_match_results.jsonl and the v1.0 DATASET_CARD.md intent-match section for the triage detail.

integrity.routable_ip_tokens: all globally-routable dotted quads are OSPF/BGP router-id identifiers (conventional lab placeholders, e.g. 1.1.1.1) in v0.1 seed-era rows; every assigned address, peer, network and next-hop is RFC1918 or an IETF documentation range
